card.name: Effect starting a heading
card.fires_on: The word Effect at the start of a section, table or figure title, right after a number such as 7.2 or Table 11:. It is usually followed by "of ... on ..." in drug interaction headings.

modes.label: Interaction section headings
modes.description: Effect opens a numbered subsection title like 7.1 or 7.2 about one drug's influence on another.
modes.example: 7.2<< Effect>> of XTANDI on Other Drugs Certain

modes.label: Figure and table titles
modes.description: Effect opens a caption for a figure or table of pharmacokinetic results.
modes.example: Table 11:<< Effect>> of Voriconazole on Pharmacokinetics

card.writes: It pushes toward the word effect and its variants, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the word Effect when it begins a heading such as "Effect of Drug A on Drug B".
